title: Restriction identifies the strict finite quotient tower
statement: For a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l, an embedding iota:E→L and a scheme W, suppose direct is a functor from flat-term K-flat completed E-complexes to strict L-system complexes, with natural isomorphisms between each evaluated complex and the specified finite scalar complex. Assume the successor transition on every degree and local section is the prescribed quotient transition conjugated by these isomorphisms. Restrict the system to a tower of completed L-modules and exchange towers with complexes. There is then a natural isomorphism of towers from this restricted tower to the specified finite scalar tower. Its nth component is exactly the canonical restriction-evaluation comparison followed by restriction of the given nth isomorphism. The strict systems and their transition maps are those of [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site].

source.place: Integral operations and normalized coefficient reduction model.

proof.text: The given transition equation identifies successor squares on every local section. The characterizations of restriction and sequence transitions show that both compute the same horizontal restriction. Extensionality gives naturality as chain maps. Successor naturality extends to every tower arrow; the given invertible level maps assemble into a tower isomorphism. Their naturality in the good complex gives functoriality.

mathlib_searches.query: Roos mapping cone total right derived inverse limit strict towers natural isomorphism canonical projection
mathlib_searches.results: Eight mapping-cone comparison lemmas, including CochainComplex.mappingCone.mapHomologicalComplexIso; no theorem giving this coefficient-tower derived-limit comparison with its canonical projections.
Seven comparison lemmas, including mapHomologicalComplexCompIso and its component equations; used to compare exact restriction and evaluated complexes.
Mathlib gives adjunction uniqueness; no specialized completed coefficient-system theorem. Project StrictRoosComparison supplies the derived-limit ingredient.

mathlib_searches.query: Restriction of scalars commutes with evaluating a strict tower of complexes and preserves its quotient transition maps.
mathlib_searches.results: ModuleCat.restrictScalars in Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.ChangeOfRings and PresheafOfModules.restrictScalarsObj in Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Presheaf.ChangeOfRings supply restriction constructions, not the specified tower comparison and transition equation.

theorem coefficientExtensionRestrictedTower_exists
    (direct : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory ⥤
      CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l L W) ℤ)
    (directEvaluation : ∀ n : ℕ,
      direct ⋙ (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
        (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).ι ⋙ integralScalarFiniteComplex l E L ι W n)
    (htransition : IsCoefficientExtensionStrictTransition l E L ι W direct directEvaluation) :
    ∃ e : direct ⋙ (coefficientSequenceRestriction l L W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
        HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex ≅
      (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).ι ⋙ integralScalarTowerFunctor l E L ι W,
      ∀ (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory) (n : ℕ),
        (e.hom.app P).app (op n) =
          (coefficientRestrictedComplexEvaluation l L W n).hom.app (direct.obj P) ≫
            ((scalarReductionRestriction l L W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
              ((directEvaluation n).hom.app P)
